title: Hammer-2024-antagonistic-10.1038/s42003-024-06732-2
description: Stereo-EEG epochs from 25 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy undergoing presurgical monitoring, recorded while they alternated between an external-attention visual search task and an internal-attention autobiographical question task. Epochs span -4 to +4 s around each task switch (external-to-internal or internal-to-external). They are bipolar-referenced and restricted to channels in the default mode and dorsal attention networks. This is a BIDS repackaging of the authors' preprocessed derivative data.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded with DIXI Medical depth electrodes and Quantum/NeuroWorks amplifiers at 2048 Hz. The authors downsampled the data to 512 Hz, removed channels in pathological zones, and applied bipolar referencing, a 0.1 Hz high-pass filter and a 50 Hz notch filter with harmonics. Epochs were cut around task switches. Contacts were localised on post-implantation CT coregistered to MRI and normalised to MNI space. Channels were assigned to the DMN or DAN with the Yeo-7 atlas. The release does not state the physical unit of the signals; the µV label in the BIDS channels is an assumption by the repackagers, not a statement by the authors.
